description: Source code for SettingsPayloadDecoder class handling HTTP/2 SETTINGS frame payload decoding in the quiche HTTP/2 implementation.

classes.name: SettingsPayloadDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for processing HTTP/2 SETTINGS frame payloads.

methods.name: StartDecodingPayload
methods.description: Begins decoding the payload of a SETTINGS frame, handling ACK frames and starting settings decoding.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingPayload
methods.description: Resumes decoding of a SETTINGS frame payload after partial decoding.

methods.name: StartDecodingSettings
methods.description: Decodes individual settings within the payload.

methods.name: HandleNotDone
methods.description: Handles cases where decoding is incomplete or errors occur.
